Section 3: a tibble

plot_df = 
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(1000, sd = 0.5),
    y = 1 + 2*x + rnorm(1000)
  )

head(plot_df)
## # A tibble: 6 × 2
##        x      y
##    <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1 -0.851 -3.07 
## 2  0.162  0.613
## 3 -0.859 -0.434
## 4 -0.324  3.00 
## 5  0.813  2.14 
## 6  0.238  1.63

Section 5: learning assessment 2

This plot shows the distribution of the absolutes value of \(X \sim N(1, 1)\)

la_df = tibble(
  num_var = rnorm(500, mean = 1),
  log_var = num_var > 0, # logical factor means T or F
  abs_var = abs(num_var)
)

ggplot(la_df, aes(x = abs_var)) + geom_histogram()
## `stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value `binwidth`.

The median is 0.89.
